title: Chapter 1291 - 37: Is That Enough?
content:
Chapter 1291 - 37: Is That Enough?

Chapter 1291: Chapter 37: Is That Enough?

...

At the center of heaven and earth, within a secret world that has been opened, lies the common stronghold of several great Eternal Sects.

Since the realization of the ’magic’ disaster by each Eternal Lord, many preparations were made in advance, such as merging the strongholds of several great Eternal Sects. Only in this way could all powers be united to resist the ’magic’ disaster.

The fact has proven that this approach was correct.

If the several great Eternal Sects had not merged in time, when the ’magic disaster’ descended, that Demon God would first strike, Source Demons would rampage, and even if the several great Eternal Sects were not completely destroyed, one or two would surely perish.

In the premise that the Eternal Lord cannot intervene, even with many thirteenth-order means of protection, such as thirteenth-order weapons, it would be very difficult for any single Eternal Sect to resist the rampage of the Source Demons.

Thirteenth-order weapons can only unleash their maximum power in the hands of a true Eternal Lord; below the Eternal Lord, even holding a thirteenth-order weapon, the power wielded is limited.

"Recently, the frequency of the Source Demons’ actions has increased, and I can feel the power of that Demon God growing stronger." In the depths of the secret world, figures sat, among them a man with an ancient face spoke.

This man with an ancient face was the Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect, the most powerful cultivator within the great power of an Eternal Sect, but at this moment his expression was heavy.

"If worse comes to worst, we fight those ’demons’. I refuse to believe that with the full strength of our Eternal Sects, we cannot suppress those Source Demons." A figure spoke with a tone of fury.

"Recklessly using all our resources can indeed clear out the Source Demons, but what about afterward? Once the resources are exhausted, but the Source Demons die, they will resurrect. How will we deal with the reborn Source Demons?"

"Right, the Demonic Qi remains, the ’demons’ are immortal."

Figures spoke, feeling frustrated; as high-ranking members of Eternal Sects, how glorious they were? Yet now they are forced to hide here.

"To clear out the magic disaster, that Demon God must be suppressed, but to suppress the Demon God, with just us..."

Another Sect Master of an Eternal Sect spoke, aware of the power of the Demon God; without the Eternal Lord, there is nothing that can be done against that Demon God.

However, the Eternal Lords of various great Eternal Sects cannot intervene, thus creating a deadlock.

Unless a new Eternal Lord is born, the current situation cannot be reversed.

But is the birth of an Eternal Lord that easy? Especially with the pervasive Demonic Qi, making cultivation increasingly difficult.

The hope of giving birth to an Eternal Lord became even more remote.

At this moment—

The Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect was slightly moved.

Raising his right hand, a golden rune appeared.

The Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect pondered for a while, looking at the other figures, and said, "Everyone, there is something that needs to be mentioned."

The Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect gave a brief explanation.

"What? At the edge of the world, a cultivator has emerged comparable to a Source Demon?"

"He wants to trade with our Eternal Sects, hoping to obtain all the rune inheritances? Including the rune inheritance created by the great Eternal Lords?"

"Such arrogance, the rune inheritances of the Eternal Lords are our very foundation, not something to be given away lightly."

"And, is that cultivator really on par with a Source Demon? Is it true?"

...

Figures conversed quickly, most expressing doubt about Lin Yuan’s strength.

On par with a Source Demon?

The combat power of a Source Demon surpasses even that of the Eternal Son.

What could a cultivator outside the Eternal Sects have to match a Source Demon?

"The intelligence should be reliable."

"The strength of that cultivator is not likely to be significantly exaggerated."

The Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect pondered for a moment, speaking with certainty.

The man with silver eyes was his disciple, and the Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect was well-acquainted with this disciple, knowing he wouldn’t exaggerate things deliberately.

Since Lin Yuan’s strength was affirmed to surpass that of the Eternal Son, nearing or even matching a Source Demon, then it should not differ by much.

"The intelligence is reliable?"

The many figures exchanged glances.

Outside the Eternal Sects, has such a strong figure really emerged?

"Actually, there’s no need to be too surprised."

The Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect spoke: "Before the great change in heaven and earth, the Eternal Lords arranged many measures, among them placing their inheritance entrances in various corners of the world."

Upon these words.

The figures suddenly understood.

Indeed.

In the eyes of the great Eternal Lords, combating the magic disaster relies very little on the Eternal Sects alone.

The power of all cultivators in this world is needed to unite.

Hence, the arrangements to place their inheritances across the world.

"If such a strong cultivator truly exists, then a trade might not be out of the question."

A Sect Master of an Eternal Sect pondered, acknowledging that the foundational inheritances of various great Eternal Sects are indeed precious.

But no matter how precious, it must be passed on.

"What do you all think?"

The Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect looked around.

Lin Yuan sought the rune inheritances of all Eternal Sects.

Therefore, this trade required the consent of the other Sect Masters of the Eternal Sects.

"No problem."

"But I want to see what that cultivator offers in exchange for our sects’ foundational inheritances."

Several Sect Masters of the Eternal Sects nodded.

"Then let us speak with him face-to-face."

The Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect looked at the golden runes in front of him.

Then he waved his hand.

The golden runes trembled.

Immediately, a scene was projected.

It was the depths of the Qingyun Institute.

...

The depths of the Qingyun Institute.

The man with silver eyes stood obediently after contacting his sect master, waiting for a response.

Lin Yuan wasn’t in a hurry either.

Involving all the rune inheritances of the Eternal Sect, it definitely won’t be agreed to easily.

Soon after.

The blue rune in front of the man with silver eyes also started to tremble.

An image appeared.

It was the world where the major Eternal Sects’ strongholds were located at the center of the world.

"Sect Master."

The man with silver eyes and the other two Eternal Envoys bowed quickly.

"Are you the one wanting to trade with our Eternal Sect?"

The Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect looked at Lin Yuan through the image created by the two communication runes.

"Yes."

Lin Yuan smiled as he looked at the figures in the image.

"Since it’s a trade, what can you offer?"

The Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect straightforwardly asked.

The implication was that Lin Yuan’s requests could be agreed to.

"I can help you... deal with some Source Demons."

Lin Yuan said with a smile.

At the center of the world, most of the Source Demons were gathered.

And these Source Demons were putting a lot of pressure on the several major Eternal Sects.

Actually, even without discussing a trade with the Eternal Sect,

Lin Yuan was already planning to deal with those Source Demons soon.

Now, after opening his Personal Particle World, just killing those Greater Demons and Ginormous Demons wasn’t enough.

To more quickly complete the development of the Infinite Constant Sand Particle World, he could only try to kill Source Demons.

"Deal with some Source Demons?"

The Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect stared at Lin Yuan.

The other figures in the image also looked at Lin Yuan: "Do you have the strength to deal with Source Demons? And deal with some Source Demons?"

According to the man with silver eyes’ description, Lin Yuan’s strength was comparable to a Source Demon.

But being comparable to a Source Demon didn’t mean he could handle a Source Demon.

Source Demons are immortal, but cultivators can be gravely injured and eroded by Demonic Qi.

A cultivator whose strength is comparable to a Source Demon has only reached the Source Demon level in terms of attack methods, but to say to deal with Source Demons? And deal with some Source Demons?

How is that possible?

Risking one’s life to hold off a Source Demon is already excellent.

Lin Yuan smiled faintly, without explanation.

Instead, he stood up slowly and took a step.

Instantly appearing in an area filled with swirling Demonic Qi, along with the three Eternal Envoys.

"Where is this?"

The man with silver eyes looked around, he could only deduce that they were no longer on the Qingyun Sacred Mountain.

It could even be said they were extremely far from the Qingyun Sacred Mountain.

In the image formed by the blue communication runes.

The Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect and other Sect Masters of the Eternal Sects also sensed the change in location.

However.

Before the Sect Masters of the Eternal Sects could say anything.

They saw Lin Yuan stretch out his hand, gathering black and white auras, forming a Yin Yang Long Sword.

Then he casually waved it lightly.

Whoosh!

The endless Demonic Qi was torn apart, where the black and white sword light passed, the ’demons’ dissolved without a struggle.

No matter the Greater Demons or the Ginormous Demons, even a terrifying ’demon’ with strength reaching the Source Demon level, under the black and white sword light, crumbled like snow meeting sunshine.

After one sword strike, where the eye could see, there was no trace of Demonic Qi or ’demons’, only sword energy that shattered and dissolved everything.

Lin Yuan extended his left hand, and when he retracted it, there was already a mass of extremely pure Demonic Qi, gained from slaying all the ’demons’.

Grasping the mass of Demonic Qi and casually absorbing it into his body, Lin Yuan glanced at the image formed by the blue communication runes.

As if to say:

"Is it enough?"
